scripts.model: if ! command -v souther >/dev/null; then echo 'souther is not on the PATH. Install it, and the wasm backend beside it: see README.md' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f ../../packages/wasm/dist/cli.js ]; then echo 'The glue has not been built. From packages/wasm: npm ci && npm run build' >&2; exit 1; fi; souther compile --target wasm model -o public/cart.wasm && souther-wasm-bindings public/cart.wasm -o src/cart.ts
scripts.build: npm run model && tsc --noEmit && vite build
